result.topic_en: Gauss works out Newton's construction of a conic section with complex-number methods: ends of the semi-axes, points given by $mb+n/b$, the corresponding points of the directrix, and a numerical example.
result.transcription:
Newtons Kegelschnitts Construction [Math. 26] (3) $p_3$ [-47-] $\frac{4}{5}$
$m+n$, $m-n$ Halbaxen
[-K Cor-] $m+n$, $(m-n)i$ Endpunkte.
$mb+\frac{n}{b}$ der Punkt b eben so $\gamma, \delta, \varepsilon$; c, d, e
$b\gamma\delta\varepsilon=1$
Ein unbestimmter Punkt [-f-]; $m\varepsilon\varrho+\frac{n}{\varepsilon\varrho}=p$ r[?]
Entsprechender Punkt der Directrix
[-Man setze-]
$\frac{\frac{1}{\delta}mm-\varepsilon mn+(\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{\gamma})nn}{n}=f+g$
$\frac{(b+\gamma)mm-\frac{1}{\varepsilon}mn+\delta nn}{n}=f-g$
[-R-]Punkt der Directrix $f+g\frac{\varrho+1}{\varrho-1}=f+g\frac{\varrho^{\frac{1}{2}}+\varrho^{-\frac{1}{2}}}{\varrho^{\frac{1}{2}}-\varrho^{-\frac{1}{2}}}$
$=f+\frac{gi}{\tang\frac{1}{2}R}$ wenn $\varrho=\cos R+i\sin R$
In unserm Beispiele $m=75^{mm}$, $n=22^{mm}5$
$b=100^\circ$ $f+g=-58,439+255,755i$
$\gamma=140^\circ$ $f-g=-58,322+98,690i$
$\delta=250^\circ$ $f=-58,380+177,221i$
$\varepsilon=230^\circ$ $g=-0,058+78,531i$
$\mathfrak{R}=\frac{(f+g)\varrho-(f-g)}{\varrho-1}=$
Der dem Punkte d in der Directrix entsprechende ist
$\mathfrak{D}=\frac{m^3-\frac{(b+\gamma+\delta)}{b\gamma\delta}\varepsilon mmn+(\frac{1}{b}+\frac{1}{\gamma}+\frac{1}{\delta})\delta mnn-\frac{1}{b\gamma}n^3}{(\delta-\varepsilon)mn}$
Also
$\mathfrak{D}-b=\frac{(m-n\gamma\varepsilon)(m-nb\delta)(m-n\delta\varepsilon)}{(\delta-\varepsilon)mn}=\frac{(b-d)(c-e)(b-c)}{b-\delta\ \gamma-\varepsilon\ b-\gamma\ \delta-\varepsilon}$
$\mathfrak{D}-c=\frac{(m-nb\varepsilon)(m-n\gamma\delta)(m-n\delta\varepsilon)}{(\delta-\varepsilon)mn}=\frac{c-d\ b-e\ b-c}{(b-\varepsilon\ \gamma-\delta\ b-\gamma\ \delta-\varepsilon)mn}$

Point of the directrix as f + g(ρ+1)/(ρ-1), rewritten via half-angle tangent
Numerical example evaluating f±g, f, g
Point R of the directrix as a Möbius-type expression in ρ
Formula for the directrix point D corresponding to d and factorized differences D-b, D-c
